description: An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Photoshop in pure Rust
summary: PhotoCraft is a clean-room Photoshop in pure Rust—layers, adjustment layers, real PSD round-tripping, GPU compositing on wgpu, no Electron—and what gets me is that every action is exposed as a command over a JSON control channel or an MCP server, so you can drive a full image-editing engine from a script or an agent loop the same way I drive Claude sessions from my phone with AgentOn Pocket. It's the kind of local-first, composable tooling I want more of: a native binary you can observe, trust, and slot into a pipeline without a vendor lock-in or a 400 MB Node runtime.
